verdict_explanation: This raw verdict records the full theorem’s explicitly broader ambient and parameter domains. It does not identify an invalid theorem, missing source instance, or deficient source-obligation proof. Restricting to E=ℝᵈ and β≥0 gives the cited equivalence after derivative-notation elaboration. The candidate already states the differences, so no repair overlay is required.

source_review.evidence: Accepted scope: the selected C2 equivalence obligation, recovered by specializing E to Euclidean d-space and β to a nonnegative real. No admission of the subsequent Lipschitz-gradient consequence or claim of literal full-domain equality. Independently opened the pinned primary source. Definition 1.12 and Proposition 1.13 support exactly the selected equivalence obligation after Euclidean/nonnegative specialization. The candidate distinguishes its broader scope and excludes the subsequent Lipschitz claim. The displayed C² proof first uses C²⇒C¹ and the preceding equivalence. It proves actual gradient and iterated-derivative negation identities, then applies the signed lower Hessian equivalence to −f with m=−β in both directions. The lesson formulas describe precisely these transformations, and diagonal iterated Fréchet evaluation is the Euclidean Hessian quadratic form. No replacement matrix or unverified Hessian field is introduced. Source Proposition 1.6 explains the derivative-limit and segment-FTC route underlying the omitted Proposition 1.13 proof. The embedded module calls the local dependency; the internal implementation of that imported dependency was outside this bounded packet review.
